description: The recipes an edit can use: the house recipes on the shelf (the starters, and any the style study has produced) and this workspace's own saved recipes. A house recipe needs a font file this build lacks: it is left out for that build. Each has id, name, family, studied, source, version, default_for (the accounts it is the default for), summary (two plain lines), cover_gif_url (the looping preview, when drawn), archived and the full recipe, always schema 2. House ids start with house:. Archived recipes are left out unless include_archived is true.

family.description: A format family id: recipes often used with it are listed first; none is left out, because any recipe fits any format

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

include_archived.description: Also list recipes taken out with recipe_archive

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_list
title: List recipes
